body_evidence.label: Hand across the body at release

explanation.basis: Compared with this athlete's 23 other analysed throws (same method version).
evidence: The slide (it moved 22 in left after landing).
The carry (it landed 12 in shorter than usual, about 0.5 m/s slower release).
Release angle +6.2° against usual (noise 3.0°); on its own, in a drag-free flight, about 4 in less carry.
explanation.observed: Ended off the board, 13 in short and 34 in left of the hole. First contact 12 in short of the usual spot.
explanation.observed_detail: First contact 12 in short of the usual spot.
explanation.possible_explanation: The difference arose after landing (the slide), not in the flight; no release measure accounts for a single throw's slide.
explanation.suggestion: Watch the landing in the side view (bag flat or on edge, spin) and compare with throws that stayed.

attribution.sentence: Off the board: 13 in short, 34 in left. Most of the left came from the slide (it moved 22 in left after landing).
